meta.title: Create VM: System NAS | ProxMenux Documentation
meta.description: Create NAS virtual machines on Proxmox VE with ProxMenux. Supports Synology DSM (loader), TrueNAS SCALE / CORE, OpenMediaVault, XigmaNAS, Rockstor, ZimaOS and FygoOS. Umbrel OS is available via community script.
meta.ogTitle: Create VM: System NAS | ProxMenux Documentation
meta.ogDescription: Create NAS virtual machines on Proxmox VE with ProxMenux. Supports Synology DSM (loader), TrueNAS SCALE / CORE, OpenMediaVault, XigmaNAS, Rockstor, ZimaOS and FygoOS.

header.title: Create VM: System NAS
header.description: ProxMenux supports eight NAS operating systems as dedicated VMs, plus an optional Umbrel OS path via a community script. Most systems share the same auto-ISO flow; Synology DSM uses a specialised loader wizard.

intro.title: How the NAS selector works
intro.body: For the generic ISO flow, the NAS selector tries to detect the latest stable release from the project’s mirror, uses a fallback version if needed, downloads the ISO and opens the shared VM configurator for CPU, RAM, disks and networking. Synology DSM and ZimaOS use dedicated installer flows.

cards.name: Synology DSM
cards.tagline: DiskStation Manager with the ARC / RR loader. Requires configuring the loader before first boot.

cards.name: TrueNAS SCALE
cards.tagline: Debian-based TrueNAS with Docker apps in current releases and ZFS as the primary filesystem. Kubernetes was used by older SCALE releases.

cards.name: TrueNAS CORE
cards.tagline: FreeBSD-based TrueNAS focused on ZFS storage. Jails and plugins in CORE 13.3 are obsolete and unsupported.

cards.name: OpenMediaVault
cards.tagline: Lightweight Debian-based NAS with a modular plugin architecture. Great for older hardware.

cards.name: XigmaNAS
cards.tagline: FreeBSD-based NAS — the original successor to FreeNAS, focused on ZFS and simplicity.

cards.name: Rockstor
cards.tagline: openSUSE-based NAS built around Btrfs. Rock-ons (Docker apps) extend functionality.

cards.name: ZimaOS
cards.tagline: Lightweight NAS OS focused on media, Docker apps and home automation. Uses its own installer.

cards.name: FygoOS
cards.tagline: International edition of fnOS: a Debian-based NAS with storage volumes, apps and media streaming, managed from its web interface and the Fygo apps.

umbrel.title: Community option: Umbrel OS
umbrel.bodyRich: The 9th entry in the NAS menu is Umbrel OS. It runs a community-scripts installer maintained outside ProxMenux, so it is not documented here. The installer handles the entire lifecycle and prints its default credentials at the end.

zfsMem.title: ZFS memory rule of thumb
zfsMem.bodyRich: For TrueNAS, allocate at least 8 GB RAM for basic operation and more for demanding workloads. ZFS uses RAM for its ARC cache, but there is no universal 8 GB performance cliff for every ZFS-based NAS. Check the chosen distribution’s requirements and size memory for its disks, services and apps; lighter OMV or Rockstor setups can need less.
